def_cn: 自由至上主义者；自由至上主义的
sentence: That's all to do with the question of collective goods and the libertarian's injunction against paternalism.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 本课核心政治哲学术语，指主张个人自由权优先于国家干预的理论立场。

sentence: The strong rights theory we turn to today is libertarianism. Libertarianism takes individual rights seriously.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 本课讨论的核心政治哲学流派名称，理解整节课论证的前提。

sentence: And the state, the government, has no business coercing them, us, to wear seat belts by law. It's coercion, so no paternalist legislation.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 自由至上主义反对国家干预的核心理由，是论证的关键概念。

sentence: Redistribution is a kind of, if you think about it, says libertarianists, a kind of coercion.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 政治哲学中关于财富分配的核心议题，本课争论的焦点。

def_cn: 家长式统治的；家长主义者
sentence: One of them is paternalist legislation. That's passing laws that protect people from themselves.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 描述以保护他人为由干预其自由的法律或政策，是自由至上主义批判的对象。

sentence: If you want to take rights seriously, if you don't want to just regard people as collections of preferences, the fundamental moral idea to which you will be led is the idea that we are the owners or the proprietors of our own person.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在论证中用于表达“我们是自身的所有者”，是学术性较强的词汇。

sentence: The first he calls justice in acquisition or in initial holdings.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 诺齐克正义原则中的“获取正义”，是学术讨论中的关键术语。

sentence: Libertarians say that's also a violation of the right to liberty.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 常用于描述对权利或法律的侵犯，是论证中的高频学术词。

sentence: One of them is paternalist legislation. That's passing laws that protect people from themselves.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 政治哲学讨论中涉及法律制定的核心词汇。

sentence: And the third kind of law or policy it is ruled out on the libertarian philosophy is any taxation Or other policy that serves the purpose of redistributing income or wealth from the rich to the poor.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 本课争论的核心政策工具，是理解再分配争议的关键词。

sentence: What it amounts to is theft by the state or by the majority, if we're talking about a democracy, from people who happen to do very well and earn a lot of money.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 自由至上主义者将税收称为“盗窃”，是论证中的关键比喻。

sentence: The second principle is: did the distribution arise from the operation of free consent, people buying and trading on the market?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 自由至上主义中“自由同意”是交易正义的条件，是重要概念。

sentence: If you look at the argument the poor need the money more, at no point in that argument you contradict the fact that we extrapolated from agreed upon principles that people own themselves.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 学术论证中表示从已知原则推导出结论，是高级词汇。

sentence: Why can't you, we live in a democratic society with freedom of speech, why can't you take to the hustings, persuade your fellow citizens that taxation is unjust and try to get a majority?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 政治学术语，指竞选活动，是低频但有用的词汇。

sentence: Exactly, but in a democracy, aren't you for democracy? Yes, I'm for democracy, but hang on, democracy and mob rule are not the same thing. Mob rule? Mob rule. But in an open society, you have recourse.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论民主与暴民统治的区别时出现，是政治哲学关键词。

sentence: No, I just believe in a very limited form of democracy whereby we have a constitution that severely limits the scope of what decisions can be made democratically.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 政治哲学中限制民主决策的根本大法，是核心概念。

sentence: He replied, once we verified there was no danger to a member's property, we had no choice but to back off according to our rules. If we responded to all fires, he said, there would be no incentive to subscribe.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论私人消防公司时出现，是经济学与政策分析常用词。

def_cn: 流离失所的；被迫离开的
sentence: And that's also why it's wrong to tax the rich to help the poor, even for good causes, even to help those who are displaced by the hurricane Katrina.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论卡特里娜飓风灾民时出现，是描述社会问题的常用词。

sentence: And that's also why it's wrong to tax the rich to help the poor, even for good causes, even to help those who are displaced by the hurricane Katrina.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在案例中出现，是自然灾害相关词汇，影响听力理解。

sentence: But that violates the fundamental principle that we belong to ourselves.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 动词形式，用于描述对自我所有权原则的侵犯，是论证常用词。

sentence: He's more demanding than Joe. Joe says it is theft, maybe in an extreme case it's justified.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论极端情况下偷窃是否正当时出现，是道德哲学核心词。

sentence: But if the state has the right to take my earnings or the fruits of my labor, isn't that morally the same as according to the state the right to claim a portion of my labor?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 用于修饰道德判断，是伦理讨论中的高频副词。

sentence: So taxation actually is morally equivalent to forced labor.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在论证税收与强制劳动道德等价时出现，是学术比较常用词。

sentence: And what is forced labor? Forced labor, Nozick points out, it's what? It's slavery.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在论证税收等同于强制劳动进而等同于奴役时出现，是核心概念。

sentence: Because forced labor involves the taking of my leisure, my time, my efforts just as taxation takes the earnings that I make with my labor.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论劳动成果与税收的关系时出现，是政治经济学核心词。

sentence: Nozick says, if you think about it, taxation amounts to the taking of earnings.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论税收是对收入的索取时出现，是经济学术语。

sentence: Now Nozick and other libertarians allow that there can be a minimal state that taxes people for the sake of what everybody needs, the national defense, police force, judicial system, to enforce contracts and property rights, but that's it.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 自由至上主义中财产权是核心权利，是政治哲学关键词。

sentence: We need to look to see whether there are some stronger theories of rights that can explain the intuition which even Mill shares, the intuition that the reason for respecting individuals and not using them goes beyond even utility in the long run.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 本课核心概念，指个人拥有的不可侵犯的权利。

sentence: Why is justice the chief part and the most binding part of our morality? Well he says because in the long run. If we do justice and if we respect rights, society as a whole will be better off in the long run.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 课程主题，在密尔和诺齐克的理论中都是核心概念。

sentence: He wants to say that individual rights are worthy of special respect. In fact he goes so far as to say that justice is the most sacred part and the most incomparably binding part of morality.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论正义是道德的一部分时出现，是伦理学核心词。

sentence: Come back to that first point that he made about the property rights of the individual.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在强调个人权利优先于集体时出现，是政治哲学核心词。

sentence: It's called libertarianism because it says the fundamental individual right is the right to liberty.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 用于修饰权利或原则，是学术论证中表示基础性的常用词。

sentence: You can't just look at the end state or the result; you have to look at two principles.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在诺齐克的正义原则中，指获取正义和转让正义两条原则。

sentence: And just to make a concrete and to see what's at stake, consider the distribution of wealth in the United States.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论财富分配时出现，是经济学与政治哲学常用词。

sentence: And just to make a concrete and to see what's at stake, consider the distribution of wealth in the United States.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论财富分配时出现，是经济学术语。

sentence: And the third kind of law or policy it is ruled out on the libertarian philosophy is any taxation Or other policy that serves the purpose of redistributing income or wealth from the rich to the poor.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论再分配时出现，是经济学术语。

sentence: Now most of you would say someone that wealthy, surely we can tax them.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 本课核心政策工具，是讨论再分配的关键词。

sentence: And if you were a utilitarian, what would you do? What tax policy would you have? You'd redistribute in a flash, wouldn't you?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 动词形式，用于描述税收政策的目标，是核心论证词。

sentence: Well, there are three things that most modern states do that on the libertarian theory of rights are illegitimate, are unjust.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 用于描述自由至上主义认为不合法的政策，是核心评价词。

sentence: Now I think in certain circumstances, it becomes necessary to overlook injustice and perhaps condone that injustice, as in the case of the cabin boy being killed.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在讨论是否容忍不公正时出现，是伦理学核心词。

sentence: Well, what about that? What if we have a case where making an exception and violating individual rights actually will make people better off in the long run? Is it all right then to use people?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 现在分词形式，用于描述侵犯权利的行为，是论证常用词。

sentence: Fully to examine these two worries or objections to Mill's defense, we need to, we need to push further.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在学术讨论中表示对论证的质疑，是论证结构关键词。

sentence: So what this line of reasoning brings us to is the fundamental principle that underlies the libertarian case for rights.
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 指逻辑推理过程，是学术论证的核心概念。

sentence: Now, how many agree with that argument, agree with the libertarian argument that redistribution for the sake of trying to help the poor is wrong?
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 指自由至上主义的论证，是学术讨论的基本单位。
